options.text: Mother said to Megha leave for her office then.

Mother told to Megha to leave for her office now.

questions.solution: The correct answer is **'Mother told Megha to leave for her office then.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is an example of an **imperative** **sentence**. • Let's look at the rules of transformation: • While changing the narration of an imperative sentence, we need to follow the given steps: • The conjunction 'to' should be used in place of a comma (,) and inverted commas (“ ”). • 'said to' will be changed into 'told'. • 'to' is followed by 'V1'. • The second person 'your' will be changed into the third person 'her' i.e. according to the object of the reporting verb. • Lastly, the adverb 'now' will be changed into 'then'. • *Example: * • *The queen said to his servant, "Cook me some delicious food today." (Direct Speech)* • *The queen ordered his servant to cook her some delicious food that day. (Indirect Speech)* • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4. ​ Correct Sentence:__ *Mother told Megha to leave for her office then.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** __ • Imperative sentence का narration बदलते समय, हमें दिए गए steps का पालन करना होगा: • Conjunction 'to' का प्रयोग comma (,) और inverted commas (" ") के बजाय किया जाता है। • 'Said to' को 'ordered/ requested/ advised/ urged/ forbade, etc.' में बदल दिया गया है। • 'to' के बाद 'v1' आता है। • The second person 'your' को third person 'her' में बदल दिया जाता है यानी reporting verb के object के अनुसार। • *Example: * • *The queen said to his servant, "Cook me some delicious food today." (Direct Speech)* • *The queen ordered his servant to cook her some delicious food that day. questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is** grammatically correct**. It does not need any **improvement.**
 
• The **present continuous tense** is used to talk about **actions** and **situations** that are in progress at the moment of speaking.
 
• The following time expressions are commonly used with the present continuous tense: **today, at present, at the moment, still, now, etc.**
 
 
• *Example: The kids are **watching** TV.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence we are talking about an **action** **taking** **place** at the time of speaking.
 
• Thus we use **the present continuous form of the verb.**
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 ​

**Correct Sentence:__** *It was cloudy in the morning but **the sun is shining **now.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही है। इसमें किसी सुधार की जरूरत नहीं है।
 
• **'Present Continuous Tense' **का उपयोग उन कार्यों और स्थितियों के बारे में बात करने के लिए किया जाता है जो बोलने के समय प्रगति पर हैं।
 
• निम्नलिखित time expression आमतौर पर present continuous tense के साथ उपयोग किए जाते हैं: today, at present, at the moment, still, now, etc.।
 
 
• *Example: The kids **are** **watching TV.***
 
 
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में हम बोलने के समय होने वाली एक क्रिया के बारे में बात कर रहे हैं। इस प्रकार हम क्रिया के वर्तमान निरंतर रूप का उपयोग करते हैं।

questions.question: If a + b + c = 5 and a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = 185, then the value of ab + bc + ac lies between:

⇒ 185 = 5 [5² – 3 × (ab + bc + ca)]

⇒ 185 = 5 [25 – 3 × (ab + bc + ca)]

⇒ 3 × (ab + bc + ca) = 25 – 37

⇒ 3 × (ab + bc + ca) = -12

⇒ ab + bc + ca = (-12/3)

⇒ -4

**∴ The value of ab + bc + ac lies between -7 and -3**
